data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'bashshar', meaning 'to bring good news'. In Islamic culture, Mubashshara symbolizes blessings, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Mubashshara carries the meaning “Blessed, Fortunate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mubashshara usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubashshara total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

In addition, the name is used to celebrate good news, such as a new birth, recovery from illness, or a business success. This name serves as a constant reminder to cherish and protect the blessings in life, and to share the good news and happiness with others.

It also signifies being favored by Allah, experiencing His mercy and love, and striving towards a life full of blessings and spiritual growth. The person named Mubashshara is encouraged to reflect upon the significance of their name and to use their blessings to serve and uplift their community and the greater good.

historical_references.context: Mubashshara was a woman from the Ansar (Helpers) of Medina, who was known for her generosity and hospitality. She was also one of the wives of the Prophet Muhammad.
